offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures precision plain, roller and ball bearings and engineered components for aerospace, defense and industrial machinery. Sells mainly to original equipment makers and their suppliers, plus aftermarket and distributor channels, and makes the parts in its own plants.

primary_products.value: plain bearings; roller bearings; ball bearings; engineered components; aerospace bearings

customer_segment.value: B2B: aerospace and defense OEMs and prime contractors, industrial equipment makers, bearing distributors; B2G: US and allied defense programs, reached mainly through prime contractors

end_markets.value: aerospace; defense; industrial machinery; medical; transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: bearings and engineered components sold to OEMs, primes and distributors

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: supplies bearings and engineered components for customers' assemblies, sold to OEMs and primes; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures its own bearings from metal and other raw materials in its own plants

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with plants and customers across these regions

specialization.value: related lines: plain, roller and ball bearings and engineered components sharing precision manufacturing and aerospace and industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to aerospace and industrial OEMs and prime contractors; distributors / dealers: independent industrial bearing distributors serving aftermarket customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aerospace parts certification and export controls on defense-related products, including FAA and ITAR rules
